title: 10y yield z-score leads GLD lower
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] 10-year yield 20d z-score > 1 leads gold ETF returns lower by 2-3 days (-) via real-rate drag even in wartime; trade short GLD 3d [finance.^TNX.close -> finance.GLD.log_return]
message: Not supported as lead: TNX z>1 vs GLD only contemporaneous (r=-0.17, lag 0, perm p=0.04, Bonferroni p=0.92); lags 2-3d ~0; short GLD rule loses (hit 39%, sharpe -1.2)

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.^TNX.close rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short GLD next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] 10-year yield daily log-return leads gold ETF returns lower by 1 day (-) only contemporaneously; test as null control of the lagged real-rate drag claim [finance.^TNX.log_return -> finance.GLD.log_return] (parent: R2-0097)
